subject: Sponsored tutorial for Cutline?
body:
Hi Maya,

I run partnerships at Cutline, a browser-based video editor for small teams. We've been reading The Frame Rate for a while and your color grading tutorials are the kind of thing our users ask us for.

Would you be open to a sponsored tutorial showing a real edit done in Cutline? Happy to give you a team account. A nofollow sponsored link is fine with us.

What would that cost?

Dana
